name: Akamai Managed Databases
line: Managed PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Valkey clusters on Akamai Cloud.

free.text: Possible $100 promotional credit for 60 days; eligibility unclear

cells.regions: 26 locations with Object Storage; DB regions vary

sql.math: The database cluster costs at most $16 a month. 730 hours at $0.024 an hour would be more, so the $16 cap applies.
Suspended all month, so 0 hours are billed. It must be resumed within 180 days.

files.math: This is a database service, not file storage.

jobs.math: Does not offer a job queue or workflow service
